report.title: BUG: plain U+1F600 went from 32px to 17px after U+1F600 U+FE0E (back to normal 3 s later)
report.log:
U+1F600, first use:                         canvas 32px   DOM 32px   colour glyph
U+1F600 U+FE0E, canvas:                     17px
U+1F600 again:                              canvas 17px   DOM 17px   no colour: text glyph or missing-glyph box
U+1F600, 3 s later:                         canvas 32px   DOM 32px   colour glyph
the "again" span, never touched, 3 s later: DOM 32px

expected: every plain U+1F600 is 32px and drawn in colour
actual:   again 17px no colour, 3 s later 32px colour
